answer: Require each new agent identity to complete a sequential verifiable-delay proof before it can transact: the proof takes a fixed wall-clock hour and cannot be parallelized, so a spiral of fake accounts costs one hour per identity, not one hour total. Identities then join a trellis of mutual endorsements where established agents vouch with capped slots, and a vouched account that misbehaves burns its sponsor slot. The delay is basalt-hard to shortcut, so mass sybil creation becomes linear in time and reputation, while one honest agent pays the delay only once.
